qrcode-generator 1.4.4 — Kazuhiko Arase (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Distributed file: qrcode.js, from npm qrcode-generator@1.4.4.
Managed by backend/package.json and backend/package-lock.json.
Automatically copied by npm ci / npm install via the postinstall script.
To regenerate: run npm run vendor:copiar in backend.
Do not edit qrcode.js manually; update the npm dependency and regenerate it.
Copyright and license notice are preserved at the beginning of qrcode.js.
Generated locally in the browser; no external QR service receives certificate data.
